thread:
ana: heads-up — we need a temporary pin for runtime 3.2.1 in ap-southeast-2 for model `llama-quant-v1`. Perf regression started after the 3.3 roll and it's affecting latency p95 for long-seq jobs.

deploybot: pin-request created: PR-4578. Pin: runtime=3.2.1, models=[llama-quant-v1]. Target window: tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Link: https://deploy/reviews/4578 :spiral_calendar:

sam: can you paste the perf delta and which jobs? quick checks — is this long-context only? :eyes:

ana: mostly longseq embeddings and rerank batches. p95 latency +220ms on gpu64-quant pools. p50 largely unchanged. Failing customers: two mid-market tenants in AP with strict SLOs.

li: is there an existing compatibility shim? we tried transient K/V cache tweaks in the canary earlier. If we pin we'll need fallback routing to hosted g4 pools to avoid impacting throughput.

maria: +1 for pin if fallback routing is ok. Need release notes update and a clear rollback trigger. Suggest rollback if error rate > 1% or p95 > baseline +200ms for 15m.

sam: ok, telemetry query I ran:
```
select avg(latency_p95) as p95, error_count from inference.metrics
where region='ap-southeast-2' and model='llama-quant-v1' and runtime_version in ('3.2.1','3.3.0')
group by runtime_version
```
results: 3.3.0 p95 = 720ms, 3.2.1 p95 = 490ms. error_count for 3.3.0 doubled in same window.

ana: deploybot, can we schedule a staged pin (canary then ramp)? prefer 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m steps with automatic abort on triggers.

deploybot: schedule accepted. Canary pool: ap-southeast-2-canary-1. Rollout plan: 5% @02:10, 25% @02:40, 100% @03:10. Abort triggers: error_rate > 1% OR p95 delta > +200ms for 15m OR spike in memory OOMs.

li: who owns the rollback? ops on-call or runtime SRE?

maria: runtime SRE owns the pin and rollback, ops will execute cross-region reroute if needed. I'll be on call for the window.

ana: release notes draft: "Temporary runtime pin to 3.2.1 in AP-SOUTHEAST-2 for llama-quant-v1 to mitigate latency regressions introduced in 3.3.0. A staged rollout with auto-abort will be used. Customers may see short-lived routing adjustments." Add to changelog?

sam: add a note in the API status page pre-window and ping affected customers. I'll prepare a short blurb.

ops-bot: change window scheduled: 2024-10-03T02:00:00Z -> 2024-10-03T04:00:00Z. Incident channel: #incidents-ap. Pager duty: runtime-sre.

maria: also add a quick check to the rollout job to validate kernel selection isn't regressing quantized throughput (we saw a kernel mismatch earlier). If `kernel_mismatch_rate > 0.5%` abort.

sam: test plan for canary: run synthetic longseq job (seq_len=4096) x 100 and validate p95 and memory. I'll put the test in CI-smoke and run 01:30 UTC.

li: after pin completes, we should open a follow-up issue to root-cause the 3.3 regression — assign to runtime/compilers. Don't let this become permanent.

ana: agreed — pin is emergency mitigation only. Timeline: hold pin for up to 48h while we finish kernel diagnostics; extension requires eng-release approval.

deploybot: pin applied to canary at 02:10 (simulated). Status: in-progress.

deploybot: canary metrics snapshot: p95=495ms, error_rate=0.2%, kernel_mismatch_rate=0.0%. Proceeding to 25% @02:40. :thumbsup:

maria: monitoring looks good so far. Proceed.

deploybot: ramp to 25% completed at 02:42. Snapshot: p95=510ms, error_rate=0.3%, kernel_mismatch_rate=0.0%.

ops-bot: note — cross-region fallback route to hosted g4 pools active for 5% of traffic during ramp.

sam: CI smoke at 01:30 passed. synthetic run p95=480ms.

maria: hold for 10m before final ramp. Observability team: please tag traces with `pin=3.2.1` for postmortem.

deploybot: final ramp to 100% completed at 03:15. Post-rollout snapshot: p95=505ms, error_rate=0.4%. No OOMs observed.

ana: good. I'll post customer notice and update release notes. Thanks all.

li: follow-up issue filed: RD-7829 "Investigate runtime 3.3 quant kernel perf regression" and assigned to runtime/compilers.

maria: reminder — if any telemetry crosses abort thresholds over next 2h, rollback immediately and notify #eng-releases.

sam: leaving the thread — ping me if we need a rollback. glhf :rocket:
